title: Guaranteed restore point proposed on Standard Edition 2
expected_feedback: Critical: a guaranteed restore point is only worth anything because FLASHBACK DATABASE can return to it, and Flashback Database is Enterprise Edition only — this database is SE2. The statement buys this migration no rollback whatsoever, so the column drop is unmitigated. On SE2 the recovery artefact has to be a full table copy taken before the change, or an RMAN backup for point-in-time recovery. Two further preconditions worth confirming even on EE, since they are the usual reasons this step fails in practice: the database must be in ARCHIVELOG with a Fast Recovery Area, and creating a restore point needs an administrative privilege that a migration account normally does not hold.
violated_rule: Edition-gated mitigations must be checked against the actual edition
